THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS IN C.C.NO.1440/2023 REGISTERED FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 323, 504 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT PENDING ON THE FILE OF PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE (JR.DN.)
AND J.M.F.C., PAVAGADA, TUMAKURU DISTRICT,
REGISTERED BY THE PAVAGADA POLICE STATION.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo dated 15.01.2025 seeking withdrawal of the petition.

The said memo reads as under:
"The undersigned Advocate for the petitioner respectfully submits that, as from the information from the instructing counsel, the dispute between the parties in NC:
2025:KHC:4910 above said case is settled, hence permitted to withdraw above said petition in the interest of justice."
The petition stands dismissed as withdrawn in terms of the memo.
